scope: Author review and Lean kernel checks of six newly added prepared-data native modules; not an independent audit of their author and not a complete raw-input expander encoder.
axioms: Only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound; no sorry, extra axiom, unsafe or native_decide in the six authored modules.

endpoint.premises: fixed q, pivot in Fin q, equal-length A and B, prepared marked tag lists of matching lengths and equal selected counts, arbitrary absolute work origins, input head and prior output
endpoint.initial: source marked(A++B), target blank, all tags marked at starts
endpoint.final: source and all tags unchanged with original heads; target closed(A++Pages.output A B a b q) at origin+2N; actual output appends this word; input tape/head unchanged
endpoint.included: Payload copy, target positioning using pivot tag clock, restoration of that clock, all page scans, all page resets, all linking jumps, target rewind, and every output bit.
endpoint.excluded: Raw metadata/input loading and tag preparation, full expander identity, eventual cleanup; those remain caller obligations.

edge_cases: Pages handles q=0; Data requires a pivot and thus q>=1. Both handle N=0. Contextual page calls preserve source/target left and right contexts; data caller fixes source suffix B and target prefix A.
